summary: Proof-worth entries for the bounded fixed video-only recording producer.

entries.contract: One exact fixed display, window, or single-display global region retains its admitted canonical topology before an H.264 QuickTime video-only producer acquires native or file authority and before every admitted frame. A finite generation-bound startup owner survives callback loss, stop, cancellation, retirement timeout, false settlement, and delayed start failure after active evidence; stop closes frame admission and drains its pre-boundary set; success requires a nonzero frame count and finalized nonempty artifact; exact artifact-action decoding precedes effects; and atomic release/remove admission plus a durable exact-identity release phase recover only to released, rolled back, or explicit residual truth.
entries.worth: This catches topology scale, rotation, or peer drift; startup callback loss and cancellation authority leaks; post-stop frame admission; false zero-frame or missing-artifact success; release fault-phase ambiguity and cleanup residue; Boolean, fractional, overflow, malformed-identifier, extra-key, wrong-type, or oversized-destination admission; suppressed progress-save failures; audio widening; help/schema drift; and native type errors without acquiring Screen Recording permission or recording pixels.
entries.guard: schema and static source checks; an executable deterministic compiled harness runs the production recording adapter, registry, in-memory store, lifecycle, frame-admission, terminal-truth, custody coordinator, and boot recovery with fake clock, native session, encoder/file, and broker dependencies; runtime custody-schema validation; and whole-source Swift compile only. ScreenCaptureKit, AVAssetWriter, filesystem effects, daemon, raw repo build, native UI, TCC, pixels, and media do not execute
